title: HoverPad v2.8.0 — Version History, Soft-Delete Trash, Dynamic Variables & 1-Click Invite Links
notes: Added Note Version History & Soft-Delete Trash with 1-click Restore so accidental edits or deletions are never lost.
Added Dynamic {{VARIABLE}} Snippet Placeholders that prompt for values before copying.
Added Category Filter Pills (All, Starred, Encrypted, Trash) and 1-Click Shareable Invite Links (?join=CODE).
Added Export Note (.md) and Full Workspace Backup (.json) to the 3-dot note menu, plus REPLICA IDENTITY FULL for zero-drop realtime sync.
